findings: Y02 ordinary producer rejects the conflicting delivery and dispatches original value 1 with exact age 20 ms; the reference reads 120 ms from the refused later response. Collision invalidation versus admission-bound interpretation requires owner disposition.

Y03 ordinary dispatch-only policy replaces the fresh queued action with an already stale newer-request chunk, then refuses it at dispatch. This is observed policy behavior and a possible usefulness improvement, not a violation of the frozen latest-request rule. Any new admission guard must be separately named and provided to the conventional comparator too.
